reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and I would scan it before ordering. Plain bisglycinate with no oxide is what I look for, and I would skip the Complex because citrate gives me stomach cramps. I would try one box, and I would not subscribe until I know the capsules are not huge.
objection: The listing doesn't show how big the capsules are, and I hate big pills. Two capsules a day is already a lot to swallow, and at $1 a day for 200 mg I'd expect a small capsule. A brand with no reviews also gives me nothing to check that against.
would_change_my_mind: A photo of the capsule next to a coin or a hand, or a few verified reviews saying they are easy to swallow.
